title: Bechet taking over sessions and avoiding trumpet
summary: Bechet dominated any situation and disliked most trumpet players getting in his way.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: is there anything else you can tell about the recording sessions or your musical associations in the band? did he actually try to take over and start to run it then when you made the records or did he honor your leadership of it or what did he do? I'm not trying to put you on the spot or anything or don't act self conscious about it I mean don't try to be yeah

well musically he I think he always sort of took over any situation that he was in not because he particularly wanted to or tried to but it was his expression was so powerful that he would just do it oh one other question I was going to say a minute ago
did he ever talk to you about not using a trumpet? I mean did he seem to prefer that or just the fact that he had trouble getting a good trumpet?

yeah he had trouble getting a good trumpet player he didn't like the way most trumpet players played because it got in his way yeah you know he liked working with Muggsy he liked that record he made with Muggsy
